T2Helix architecture commitment (2026-05-10, claude-opus-4-7-1m-claude-code with Anthony, hypothesis layer pending implementation):

T2Helix is a Claude Code plugin that crystallizes Sovereign Stack methodology into a product layer that ships entirely on a user's local machine, with NO dependency on Sovereign Stack infrastructure. Substrate: filesystem-addressed memory at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA} (~/.claude/plugins/data/t2helix/). Storage: SQLite append-only chronicle.db (insights, threads, goals, handoffs, compass_log tables) + JSON self_model + checkpoints/ archive. Distribution: Anthropic plugin manifest + hooks.json + in-process Node MCP server (createSdkMcpServer) + goal-anchor SKILL.md.

Five hooks carry the substrate integration into Claude Code's agent loop:
  1. UserPromptSubmit → recall + state orientation (additionalContext ≤10K chars, reads canonical SQLite)
  2. PreToolUse → compass gate (WITNESS=deny / PAUSE=ask / OPEN=proceed via permissionDecision)
  3. PostToolBatch → goal coherence nudge (goal + open threads as additionalContext)
  4. PreCompact → checkpoint archive (preserves full transcript before compaction summarizes it)
  5. Stop → session synthesis + handoff write + self-model update

MCP tools (mcp__t2helix__*): recall, record, open_thread, get_open_threads, set_goal, get_state, where_did_i_leave_off. Same primitive contract as Sovereign Stack, local SQLite backend instead of remote stack.

Compass starts as heuristic rules engine (compass-rules.json with explicit pattern matches: rm-rf-wildcard, git-push-force, drop-table, deploy-prod, edit-without-tests, ambiguous-spec). Optional ONNX classifier upgrade later. Fails OPEN on uncertainty, never WITNESS-by-inference.

Status: design committed, no code written. MVP scope still open (see paired open thread).
